title: Mapping the Challenges of HCI: An Application and Evaluation of ChatGPT and GPT-4 for Mining Insights at Scale
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not use a benchmark to measure aspects of faith/religion. Instead, through a topic modeling analysis of extracted research challenges from HCI literature, it identified 'Rituals and religion' as one of 113 distinct research topic clusters.
findings: The analysis identified 'Rituals and religion' as a minor research topic cluster within the HCI field, based on the CHI 2023 proceedings. This topic contained 13 distinct research challenges and was thematically grouped with games, interaction, and engagement.
